name: Individual Identification Number (IIN)
issuer: the National registers of identification numbers
note: Kazakhstan's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: the Individual Identification Number (IIN) is a unique 12-digit combination generated for an individual at the initial registration in the system that produces documents, kept in the National registers of identification numbers, never changed; the twelfth digit is a control digit by a two-cycle weighted modulus 11 the sheet spells out, which the game doesn't compute yet (`check` left out). Individuals get it automatically. Read as given on registration, to residents. No fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Kazakhstan: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: Individual identification number (hereinafter - IIN) is a unique combination of 12 digits generated for an individual during the initial registration in the information-production system for producing documents. ... the IIN provides for the presence of a control 12th digit ... Individuals Yes Entities Yes
